wildhunt.skill.storm_crown.description: Railbolt consumes up to three charges for +25% damage each. Fulgurite rods strike nearby targets to recharge it. Storm Mantle gains charge by moving. Wet targets take 30% more damage. Damage grows with EP and mastery. Master this skill to unlock its Ultimate as Sovereign Hunter.
